description: A JSON number whose binary exponent doesn't fit in 32 bits, such as 1e2147483647, is an error
notes: The spec requires an error only for a number that can't be represented exactly, and an arbitrary-precision decimal can represent 10^2147483647, so the spec doesn't decide. hashicorp/hcl parses JSON numbers with go-cty's ParseNumberVal (parseNumber in json/parser.go), which uses math/big: it rejects a literal whose binary exponent before scaling (the mantissa's bit length plus the decimal exponent, less any fraction digits) doesn't fit in a 32-bit integer, while a smaller one that overflows while scaling becomes infinity (json/expressions/number-exponent-overflow). Because hashicorp/hcl converts numbers while reading the file, the error comes in the parse phase although the file is valid JSON.
